title: Sorting and Searching
summary: Sorting arranges items (numbers ascending, strings alphabetically); searching finds a target value or its position.

sections.content: Sorting arranges items (numbers ascending, strings alphabetically); searching finds a target value or its position.
Languages provide built-in sort and search functions — use them instead of writing your own. Binary search on sorted data is dramatically faster than checking every item.
Key points: sorting mutates or returns new collections depending on language, and always sort before binary searching.
